title: Triple bond and p orbitals
statement:
How many unhybridized p orbitals on each carbon form the two pi components of acetylene?

[_]{a}

explanations: Each supplies one perpendicular pi overlap.
That suffices for a double bond, not a triple.
sp hybridization leaves two p orbitals.
One p orbital already contributes to the sp hybrids.

hints: Each carbon has two electron domains.
Its two sp hybrids use only one p orbital.
The remaining two p orbitals form distinct pi overlaps.
solution: Each carbon has two electron domains. Its two sp hybrids use only one p orbital. The remaining two p orbitals form distinct pi overlaps. Each supplies one perpendicular pi overlap.
